purpose: Measure typed constants, materialized results, operand uses, memory operations, calls, and terminators in the trusted Stage0 typed IR for the exact canonical compiler source. This is a sizing/differential oracle only; it is not a claim that Stage1 IR-v2 must duplicate Stage0 IR one-for-one.

planned_stage1_value_storage.warning: The 1460-slot layout is only a candidate. If a complete Stage1 semantic IR needs more slots, the implementation must prove a valid compacting/interning/banked design; the oracle may not be ignored or calibrated away.

interpretation.capacity_rule: If the candidate Stage1 namespace is materially smaller than the reference materialized-result inventory, Stage1 must prove which results are not required or how they are safely represented/compacted. Silent omission is forbidden.
